result.title: Late Breaking Results: Audio-Language-Action Models with Direct Speech Conditioning for Robotic Manipulation
result.comment: 2 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to DAC 2026 Late Breaking Results
result.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to follow instructions in typed text, limiting broader deployment in natural speech. The traditional solution by prepending a speech recognition before VLA to convert speech into texts would incur additional latency and propagate errors. To address this, we present Speech-$π_{0.5}$, which maps raw speech directly to motor commands without explicit textual transcriptions. Specifically, built on $π_{0.5}$, we use a cross-modal projection to convert voice frames directly into audio tokens with significant response latency reduction. To further improve the accuracy, we adopt split LoRA adaptation with dedicated audio and task adapters, under a two-stage training. Speech-$π_{0.5}$ achieves $3\times$ lower response latency than ASR pipeline while maintaining competitive task success on LIBERO, and generalizes robustly to unseen accents where a single adapter degrades significantly.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Speech-π0.5，在 π0.5 视觉-语言-动作模型上用跨模态投影把原始语音帧直接映射为 audio tokens，跳过 ASR 转写，并以 audio/task 分离 LoRA 两阶段训练；在 LIBERO 上延迟约为 ASR 流程的 1/3，成功率有竞争力，对未见口音更稳健。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「原始模态帧经跨模态投影压缩为 token」与「模态专用适配器」可供核查，可能关联到 LVR 中非文本证据被压入表示后的信息保留与跨分布泛化问题，但论文任务是机器人语音操作，不直接研究视觉推理。
